questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign tells you to yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black lettering alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This pennant-shaped yellow sign indicates a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to immediate road conditions. These signs often include a recommended speed. Follow the speed shown for safe passage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red traffic light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, yield to all traffic and pedestrians, and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles moving slower than 25 mph. Examples include construction equipment, farm machinery, and horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a reverse curve. The road will curve right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond-shaped sign warns of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to tell drivers to slow down, be careful, and look for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers which traffic laws to follow. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow on this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery and dangerous when wet. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches.
